edges: Prince Dunark is in a relationship with Princess Sitar.
Prince Dunark and Princess Sitar assist Dick Seaton and his friends against the Mardonalian ruler.
Prince Dunark and Princess Sitar assist Dick Seaton and his friends in destroying Mardonale.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Dick Seaton rescues Margaret 'Peg' Spencer along with Dorothy Vaneman.
Martin Crane's marriage to Margaret 'Peg' Spencer is solemnized by the Kondalian monarchy.
The Skylark lands on Crane's Field.
Dick Seaton befriends Prince Dunark during their journey.
Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne kidnaps Dorothy Vaneman to exchange for Element X.
They obtain Element X from an outcrop on an Earthlike exoplanet.
Dick Seaton returns to Earth after his adventures.
Dick Seaton is declared nominal 'Overlord' of Kondal by the Kondalian monarchy.
The Skylark returns to Earth laden with jewels, platinum, radium, and Element X.
Dick Seaton and his friends obtain Element X from an outcrop on an Earthlike exoplanet.
Dick Seaton is pitted against Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne as the protagonist and antagonist in the story.
